findings.title: divine source
findings.claim: The genitive divine name makes the promise explicitly God-sourced rather than an abstract prediction.
findings.mechanism: The carrier ٱللَّهِ at 18:21:7:1 is joined by the construct promise at 18:21:6:1; that grammatical contact turns the promise into a claim whose source and ownership are named as God.
findings.reader_payoff: The promise is heard as coming from a named divine source before the ayah moves to its truth and the Hour.
findings.containment: This remains a local genitive-source relation; it does not import the support text's outside-surah comparison or make a broader claim about divine names.

epistemic.reason: The aligned proper-name occurrence and local genitive construction directly support the claim.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ile seslenme ve ant biçimleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The proper-name occurrence at 18:21:7:1 carries the Creator-specific divine-name branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The genitive promise relation at 18:21:6:1 supplies the local source-and-ownership contact.
branch_activations.activation: The named divine carrier is joined to the promise as its source, so the promise is heard as Creator-owned rather than generically sacred.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promise's source is grammatically identified as the Creator before the ayah develops its truth and Hour claims.
branch_activations.boundary: This activates the proper-name facet only; it does not add invocation or oath uses.

findings.title: binding truth
findings.claim: حَقٌّ predicates the divine promise as real, fixed, and binding truth.
findings.mechanism: The carrier حَقٌّ at 18:21:8:1 follows the promise at 18:21:6:1 under the assertive frame at 18:21:5:1; the predicate gives the promised future the status of established reality.
findings.reader_payoff: Truth here is more than accurate information: the promise is presented as something that stands and binds.
findings.containment: The finding stays with the local predicate's truth-and-reality range; it does not extend to every legal or ethical use of the root.

epistemic.reason: The QAC-aligned predicate and trusted word analysis agree on its local relation to the promise.

findings.title: paired certainty
findings.claim: The conjunction couples the truth of God's promise with the certainty of the Hour as one cumulative purpose.
findings.mechanism: The carrier وَ at 18:21:9:1 links the first asserted proposition to the Hour proposition at 18:21:10:2; the conjunction makes the two results stand together rather than compete.
findings.reader_payoff: Promise and fulfillment are perceived as a paired structure within the disclosure's purpose.
findings.containment: This is a local coordination claim about the two propositions, not a ranking of them or a claim about all uses of the conjunction.

epistemic.reason: The coordinating particle and the adjacent paired propositions directly establish the relation.

findings.title: parallel assertion
findings.claim: The second أَنَّ gives the Hour its own fully asserted proposition instead of leaving it as an afterthought.
findings.mechanism: The carrier أَنَّ at 18:21:9:2 follows the first asserted content at 18:21:8:1 and opens the second subject-predicate unit headed by the Hour at 18:21:10:2.
findings.reader_payoff: The Hour receives grammatical and rhetorical weight equal to the promise's truth.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to the parallel assertion in this ayah; it does not infer an independent discourse structure beyond the supplied surface.

epistemic.reason: The repeated assertive complementizer is directly aligned and its local pairing is explicit.

findings.title: known hour
findings.claim: The definite Hour turns the sleepers' disclosure into evidence that reaches beyond their story to the recognized resurrection event.
findings.mechanism: The carrier ٱلسَّاعَةَ at 18:21:10:2 is the subject of the second assertion, triggered by the promise's truth at 18:21:8:1 and the no-doubt clause at 18:21:12:1; the discovery therefore bears on a fixed eschatological horizon.
findings.reader_payoff: The local finding is perceived as a sign for the Hour, not only as information about hidden people.
findings.containment: The reading stays with the definite Hour and the local proof structure; it does not claim a timetable or import the cited parallel passages.

epistemic.reason: The definite noun, its grammatical assertion, and the adjacent certainty language directly support the local eschatological relation.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: zamanın sürmesi ve belirli bir zaman kesiti
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dünyanın sona erip insanların yeniden dirileceği gün de bu zaman adıyla belirtilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The definite Hour occurrence at 18:21:10:2 carries the branch's resurrection-day extension.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The truth predicate and categorical no-doubt clause at 18:21:8:1 and 18:21:12:1 specify which time reference is active.
branch_activations.activation: The temporal noun meets the adjacent truth-and-certainty frame, selecting the branch's end-and-resurrection-day facet rather than an ordinary short interval.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Hour is locally fixed as the resurrection day that the disclosed sleepers make cognitively present.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not supply a date, duration, or timetable.

findings.title: categorical negation
findings.claim: لَا removes doubt as a whole category from the proposition about the Hour.
findings.mechanism: The carrier لَا at 18:21:11:1 governs رَيْبَ at 18:21:12:1 after the Hour at 18:21:10:2; the compact negation closes the proposition categorically rather than merely reducing uncertainty.
findings.reader_payoff: The Hour's certainty is heard as a grammatical exclusion of doubt, not as a request for confidence.
findings.containment: This is limited to the local negation construction and does not claim that every use of لَا is categorical.

epistemic.reason: The particle's aligned construction with the indefinite doubt noun directly supports categorical exclusion.

findings.title: doubt disturbance excluded
findings.claim: The ayah excludes destabilizing suspicion about the Hour, not merely a small amount of hesitation.
findings.mechanism: The carrier رَيْبَ at 18:21:12:1 is contacted by the categorical negation at 18:21:11:1 and the Hour at 18:21:10:2; the root's disturbance-and-suspicion range sharpens what the negation removes.
findings.reader_payoff: What disappears is the unsettling pressure of doubt around the Hour, while the standard no-doubt reading remains intact.
findings.containment: The finding keeps the local doubt range and does not use the support text's variant or wider calamity associations as separate evidence.

epistemic.reason: The aligned lexical range is direct, while the added disturbance nuance remains bounded to the local root pressure.

findings.title: hour domain closure
findings.claim: The prepositional phrase locates the no-doubt claim in the Hour itself rather than making the audience's psychology its grammatical domain.
findings.mechanism: The carrier فِيهَا at 18:21:13:1-2 points back to the Hour at 18:21:10:2 and completes the negation of doubt at 18:21:11:1-12:1; the clause is about the Hour as the domain of certainty.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence's certainty is anchored in what the Hour is, not only in how listeners feel about it.
findings.containment: This remains a local pronominal and prepositional relation; it does not deny that the claim affects hearers.

epistemic.reason: The pronoun's antecedent and its local syntactic landing are directly supplied.

findings.title: dispute scene pivot
findings.claim: إِذْ pivots from the doctrinal proof to the social scene in which the proof is contested and acted upon.
findings.mechanism: The carrier إِذْ at 18:21:14:1 follows the paired certainty and opens the dispute verb at 18:21:15:1; its temporal scene-setting lets the proof and the dispute remain connected.
findings.reader_payoff: The public sign is felt entering history at the very moment people begin to contest its meaning.
findings.containment: The temporal hinge is retained; a causal shade remains possible but is not promoted to a separate claim.

epistemic.reason: The particle's local temporal attachment is clear, while its finer attachment is explicitly left open.

findings.title: reciprocal dispute
findings.claim: The dispute is represented as ongoing reciprocal pulling over the matter, not as a one-sided correction.
findings.mechanism: The carrier يَتَنَازَعُونَ at 18:21:15:1-2 is triggered by the internal field at 18:21:16:1-2 and the named affair at 18:21:17:1-2; the Form VI morphology makes opposing participation part of the scene.
findings.reader_payoff: The argument becomes a live social tug over the revealed sign.
findings.containment: The pulling image remains a local resonance of the dispute; no external conflict narrative is added.

epistemic.reason: The reciprocal form and its local object are secure, while the physical tug image is retained as bounded root pressure.

findings.title: resumptive opening
findings.claim: The opening conjunction resumes a controlled disclosure sequence instead of severing the ayah from the preceding cave episode.
findings.mechanism: The carrier وَ at 18:21:1:1 is followed by the comparative pointer at 18:21:1:2-3 and the causative disclosure at 18:21:2:1; the opening syntax carries the reader into a continuation whose next act is divinely authored.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah begins as a continuation of the sleepers' managed story, so the disclosure feels orchestrated rather than detached.
findings.containment: The finding uses only the resumptive surface and its immediate focus sequence; it does not reproduce the support text's wider formula comparisons.

epistemic.reason: The aligned conjunction and its immediate continuation directly support a resumptive reading.

findings.title: internal dispute field
findings.claim: The conflict is located inside the group before the disputed matter is named.
findings.mechanism: The carrier بَيْنَهُمْ at 18:21:16:1-2 is placed between the reciprocal dispute at 18:21:15:1-2 and the affair at 18:21:17:1-2; the phrase makes the social interior itself the field of division.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees an internally divided community before seeing the proposals that emerge from it.
findings.containment: The primary force is internal among-ness; root associations with separation or clarity remain background rather than separate readings.

epistemic.reason: The locative relation is direct, while adjacent root possibilities are explicitly bounded.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam iki veya daha çok taraf arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konumdur.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The reciprocal dispute and its affair object at 18:21:15:1 and 18:21:17:1 make the interval a social interior.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dispute is spatially organized as an internal arena among the group.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the middle-and-interval facet and does not activate separation, clarity, or distance branches.

findings.title: contested affair
findings.claim: The affair first appears as the object the group contests and later reappears as the domain over which one group prevails.
findings.mechanism: The carrier أَمْرَهُمْ at 18:21:17:1-2 is triggered by the dispute at 18:21:15:1 and contacts the repeated governed form at 18:21:29:1-2; the repetition lets one matter move from contested object to controlled sphere.
findings.reader_payoff: The same affair can be followed across the ayah as it changes from a shared question into a question of authority.
findings.containment: The relation is confined to the two supplied occurrences and their local case frames; it does not decide among all root meanings of أَمْر.

epistemic.reason: The repeated aligned form is direct, while its shift in syntactic role supplies the bounded interpretive development.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, insan işleri arasında tek tek sayılabilen konu, hal veya durumdur.
branch_activations.carrier: The two affair occurrences at 18:21:17:1 and 18:21:29:1 carry the countable matter-and-state branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The dispute and later prevailing action at 18:21:15:1 and 18:21:27:1 give the repeated matter its changing social frame.
branch_activations.activation: The same lexical carrier is first the issue being contested and then the issue over which control is exercised.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The repeated affair is materially continuous while its social status changes from question to governed domain.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not decide whether the affair is a command, office, or another specialized use.

findings.title: result sequence
findings.claim: The sequence particle makes the first proposal arrive as the immediate result of the ongoing dispute.
findings.mechanism: The carrier فَ at 18:21:18:1 is followed directly by the first speech verb at 18:21:18:2-3; the particle compresses the movement from contention into proposal.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah gives no calm interpretive pause between argument and the first command.
findings.containment: This is a local sequencing effect, not a claim that the first proposal is correct or divinely authorized.

epistemic.reason: The particle's position between the dispute scene and reported speech directly supports the result relation.

findings.title: anonymous plural speech
findings.claim: The first construction proposal comes from an unnamed plural human voice rather than a named authority.
findings.mechanism: The carrier قَالُوا at 18:21:18:2-3 introduces the imperative at 18:21:19:1-2 without naming a speaker; the plural form keeps the proposal socially broad before the later power-defined speaker.
findings.reader_payoff: Attention stays on the proposed command while its human authority remains unresolved.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to the grammatical anonymity and plurality of this first speech; it does not infer a specific faction.

epistemic.reason: The plural speech form and absence of an expressed speaker are directly visible in the aligned surface.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The first speech occurrence at 18:21:18:2 carries the ordinary spoken-expression branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following build imperative at 18:21:19:1 and the later command framing at 18:21:24:1 make the utterance a practical proposal.
branch_activations.activation: The speech carrier meets a concrete imperative, so the anonymous plural words become an actionable program rather than mere narration.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The first group speaks a construction plan into the scene.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains spoken expression and does not activate the manager, negotiation, or imposed-rule branches.

findings.title: build command
findings.claim: The first human response converts interpretation of the sign into a direct command to construct.
findings.mechanism: The carrier ٱبْنُوا at 18:21:19:1-2 is triggered by the preceding speech at 18:21:18:2-3 and completed by the building object at 18:21:21:1; the imperative makes construction the first proposed response.
findings.reader_payoff: The sign is immediately given a material and institutional answer, even though the command's authority is unstated.
findings.containment: The finding keeps the addressee and authority open and does not treat the command as divine instruction.

epistemic.reason: The imperative and its concrete object are directly aligned, while the suppressed authority is explicitly preserved as uncertainty.

findings.title: second over them
findings.claim: The second over-them phrase turns the disclosed sleepers into bodies proposed to be covered or enclosed.
findings.mechanism: The carrier عَلَيْهِم at 18:21:20:1-2 follows the build imperative at 18:21:19:1-2 and points to the sleepers; the repeated preposition shifts the relation from disclosure landing on them to construction placed over them.
findings.reader_payoff: The sleepers remain the axis while human response changes from finding them to enclosing them.
findings.containment: Protection, concealment, and entombment remain possible nuances, not selected outcomes.

epistemic.reason: The repeated complement and its local attachment are directly supplied.

findings.title: unspecified building
findings.claim: The first proposal names an indefinite concrete structure without yet assigning it a sacred function.
findings.mechanism: The carrier بُنْيَانًا at 18:21:21:1 is triggered by the preceding build command at 18:21:19:1-2 and contrasts locally with the final mosque noun at 18:21:32:1; its indefiniteness leaves form and purpose open.
findings.reader_payoff: The first response is seen as building in general, before the second response designates a worship-place.
findings.containment: The finding stays with the local contrast between an unspecified structure and a mosque; it does not import historical building claims.

epistemic.reason: The indefinite noun, its build verb, and the supplied closing contrast establish the bounded distinction.

findings.title: lordship parenthesis
findings.claim: The Lord-title interrupts the human proposals with a personal divine relation to the sleepers.
findings.mechanism: The carrier رَبُّهُمْ at 18:21:22:1-2 opens the nominal aside before the superior-knowledge predicate at 18:21:23:1; the suffix binds the sleepers to their Lord while human plans are paused.
findings.reader_payoff: The sleepers are recentered under divine care and ownership before people resume deciding what to build.
findings.containment: The claim stays with the local suffixed title and its parenthetical position; it does not expand into a general doctrine of lordship.

epistemic.reason: The nominal interruption, suffix, and following predicate are directly aligned.

findings.title: superior divine knowledge
findings.claim: The parenthesis sets God's already superior knowledge of the sleepers against the humans' newly acquired knowledge.
findings.mechanism: The carrier أَعْلَمُ at 18:21:23:1 is triggered by the earlier human knowing at 18:21:4:2-3 and joined to the Lord-title at 18:21:22:1-2; the elative makes divine knowledge the stable center of the aside.
findings.reader_payoff: Public learning from the sign is bracketed by knowledge that is already complete and personal.
findings.containment: The comparison is limited to the two supplied local knowledge forms; it does not claim that the humans know nothing.

epistemic.reason: The aligned elative and repeated root support the contrast, while the precise comparison remains locally bounded.

findings.title: knowledge domain
findings.claim: The preposition marks the sleepers themselves as the object-domain of the Lord's superior knowledge.
findings.mechanism: The carrier بِ at 18:21:24:1 attaches the knowledge predicate at 18:21:23:1 to the pronoun at 18:21:24:2; the short phrase keeps the aside focused on persons rather than only on the disputed affair.
findings.reader_payoff: The divine aside concerns who the sleepers are, not merely what the community is arguing about.
findings.containment: This is a local preposition-and-pronoun relation and does not infer an exhaustive account of the Lord's knowledge.

epistemic.reason: The aligned prepositional complement and its pronoun are directly supplied.

findings.title: comparative hinge
findings.claim: The comparative prefix fuses with the demonstrative to present the disclosure as happening in the same patterned manner as the preceding divine handling.
findings.mechanism: The carrier كَ at 18:21:1:2 leans into ذَٰلِكَ at 18:21:1:3 and immediately governs the disclosure at 18:21:2:1; the fused formula makes the new act a continuation of an established pattern.
findings.reader_payoff: The discovery is perceived as patterned divine action rather than an isolated accident.
findings.containment: The finding stays with the local manner formula and does not reproduce the cited prior-ayah comparisons.

epistemic.reason: The fused comparative-demonstrative construction is directly aligned.

findings.title: sleepers pronoun
findings.claim: The object pronoun identifies the sleepers themselves as the persons known by the Lord.
findings.mechanism: The carrier هِمْ at 18:21:24:2 resolves the complement opened by بِ at 18:21:24:1 and follows the Lord's superior knowledge at 18:21:23:1; the pronoun keeps persons, rather than the affair, as the grammatical object.
findings.reader_payoff: The divine aside is heard as personal knowledge of the sleepers.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to the local pronominal resolution and does not infer any unstated information about their identities.

epistemic.reason: The aligned pronoun and its governing preposition provide the direct relation.

findings.title: authoritative second speech
findings.claim: The second speech frame sounds more unified and authoritative after the divine-knowledge aside.
findings.mechanism: The carrier قَالَ at 18:21:25:1 reopens human speech after the parenthesis and is followed by the power-defining relative clause at 18:21:26:1; the singular form contrasts with the earlier plural speech at 18:21:18:2-3.
findings.reader_payoff: The final proposal arrives as a consolidated stance rather than another anonymous suggestion.
findings.containment: The number shift is retained as a grammatical effect; it does not identify a particular leader or settle whether the singular is collective.

epistemic.reason: The contrast in speech framing is supplied, while the exact social referent remains open.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final declaration is speech functioning as practical authority.

findings.reader_payoff: The final proposal is read through the authority that frames it.
findings.containment: The finding does not infer the speakers' identity beyond the supplied relative clause.

epistemic.reason: The relative pronoun and its defining clause are directly aligned.
